semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in ultra-clean flow control systems and components specifically for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Zhejiang Cheer Technology Co., Ltd. is a national high-tech company focused on the development of ultra-clean flow control systems and components for the semiconductor industry. Established in 2013, the company has a strong emphasis on research and development, with significant expertise in fluid measurement and control technologies.

regional_presence.China: The company has established a pilot base in Hangzhou Qingshan Lake Science and Technology City for research and mass production.
